Friendzy / Classic party games / Mind Meld

How to play Mind Meld

Two brains. One word. Total sync. Two players count to three and both say a word at the same time. The goal: keep saying words until both say the same word simultaneously. The path there is the fun part.

2–4 players~5 minThoughtful & SatisfyingMemory & chain games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. Two players face each other.
  2. Count to three together, then both say a word simultaneously.
  3. Those two words are now both 'in play'.
  4. Count to three again — each player tries to say a word that connects the two in-play words.
  5. Keep going until both players say the same word at the same time. That's Mind Meld.

Example round

  • Round 1: 'apple' + 'car'
  • Round 2: 'road' + 'fruit'
  • Round 3: 'drive' + 'orchard'
  • Round 4: 'farm' + 'farm' — MIND MELD!

Tips

  • Think about what links the two current words — go for the obvious connection.
  • Best with 2 people but can do team vs team.
